title: Warm Brazilian-Style Pão de Queijo Wrap
description: A warm, cheesy, and comforting Brazilian-style wrap made with pão de queijo filling and wrapped in a crispy all-purpose flour pastry.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour and warm water to form a dough.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Roll out the dough into a large circle, about 1/4 inch thick.
Place the dough into a greased baking sheet.
Bake the dough in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until it becomes crispy and golden brown.
While the dough is baking, prepare the pão de queijo filling by mixing the malty syrup and Brazilian cheese in a bowl.
Once the dough is done, remove it from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Spread the pão de queijo filling onto the dough, leaving a small border around the edges.
Roll up the dough tightly and slice it into 1-inch thick rounds.
Serve the warm Brazilian-style pão de queijo wrap immediately, garnished with additional shredded cheese if desired.
